title: Neural network model for mathematical programming problems with complementary constraints
summary: In this paper, we propose a a gradient-based neural network model to solve the mathematical programming problems with complementary constraints (MPCC). In order to facilitate tractable optimization, the problem MPCC is transformed via a regularized approach into a relaxed nonlinear optimization problem NLP($β$). After that employing the penalty function and neural network model an estimate of the optimal solution of the problem NLP($β$) is obtained.
